import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_8/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_8/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_8/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_8/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_8/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_8/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_8/training_6.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = [pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0) for path in source_files]

# According to operation_history, perform UNION of all source tables
# All source tables have the same schema ['air_store_id', 'dow'], so union is valid
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema: 'air_store_id' as string, 'dow' as integer
target_df['air_store_id'] = target_df['air_store_id'].astype(str)
target_df['dow'] = target_df['dow'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_8/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
